layoutFindings: Coin lockers (#17) sit on the U+ side of the central escalator bank, between the core and 짐캐리 (SY0 60-72 s; 9ywc 351-360 s; blogs: "1층 물품보관함은 5번출구 6번출구 앞 … 보관함 바로 옆에 에스컬레이터"). They are NOT at the #9 복순도가 end. The #9 end has its own 1F->2F escalator (SY0 309-311 s).
김밥천국 is at the U+ end next to KTX특송 (SY0 130-144 s "1階端にキンパ天国"; 2025-05 guide map; 2026-03 photo), not at #6. In 2026-03, #6 was BURGER&TACO (a BT BURGER&TACO sign was also photographed).
The staff canteen (직원식당) stair is a narrow stair core between #15 새벽집 and #14 개미집 (SY0 206-217 s; tiV8 205-217 and 231-236 s). It is a vertical core inside the rear row.
